definitions.explanation: The complete human body from head to toe.

examples.japanese: {全身|ぜんしん}{鏡|かがみ}で{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked in the full-length mirror.

examples.japanese: {全身|ぜんしん}の{力|ちから}を{込|こ}めて{投|な}げた。
examples.english: I threw with all my might.

notes:
{全身|ぜんしん} refers to the entire body.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全身|ぜんしん}{鏡|かがみ} (full-length mirror)
- {全身|ぜんしん}{麻酔|ますい} (general anesthesia)
- {全身|ぜんしん}{写真|しゃしん} (full-body photo)
- {全身|ぜんしん}の{力|ちから} (all one's strength)
- {全身|ぜんしん}{運動|うんどう} (full-body exercise)
- {全身|ぜんしん}ずぶ{濡|ぬ}れ (soaked from head to toe)

HOMOPHONE:
{全身|ぜんしん} (whole body) vs {前進|ぜんしん} (advance) - same reading, different meaning.
